name: maximal_cliques
author: 62a230f4
description: Finds maximal cliques with Bron-Kerbosch pivoting and returns the largest ones. Use for questions about groups where everyone is connected to everyone else. Works on undirected graphs only. Returns max_size, how many maximal cliques exist, and the top_k cliques (each with nodes, size, and a registered subgraph). result_graph_id is the largest clique (ties broken by node ids).

graph_id.description: Id of an undirected graph, for example karate or lesmis.

top_k.description: How many largest cliques to return.
